# Trade WBTC

> Trade WBTC to move between tokenized Bitcoin and other assets on-chain — preview the route here, then execute the swap in an external trading app.

## Key facts
- Token: Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC), an ERC-20 token with 8 decimal places
- Backing / peg: 1:1 with BTC held by institutional custodians
- Convert: Swap on a DEX, or mint/redeem via approved merchants
- Networks: Ethereum mainnet (chain ID 1) plus official deployments on other chains
- Costs: Network gas; on a DEX swap add the pool fee and price impact
- Verify: Check the contract address, not the ticker
